row:
One of the largest and busiest acute hospital trusts in the country, our vision is to provide the highest quality specialist and integrated care. 

We are incredibly proud of the work we do across our seven hospitals in Leeds. Our state-of-the-art facilities enable us to deliver high-quality hospital services for the people of Leeds, Yorkshire and the Humber and beyond.

We play an important role in the training and education of medical, nursing and dental students, and are a centre for world-class research, innovation and pioneering new treatments.  

Our workforce of 20,000 staff are central to everything we do here at Leeds Teaching Hospitals and our reputation for specialist care, research and academic training is down to their hard work and dedication.

Our seen hospitals are: 
Leeds General Infirmary
St James's University Hospital
Chapel Allerton Hospital
Leeds Children's Hospital
Seacroft Hospital
Wharfedale Hospital
Leeds Dental Institute
